mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening monetary cycle with strong labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals deteriorating economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which supports economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% indicates persistent inflation that may trigger Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and INDPRO both rising) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% during a monetary easing cycle.
